# Tabbio Partner Program

> Tabbio helps CV professionals, career creators, recruiters, and agencies turn useful career work into trackable referrals.

## Key facts

- Partner commission: 30% of eligible attributed subscription payments.
- Main workflow: apply, complete required checks, share a partner link, track commission.
- Partner tools: client CV handoff, tracked links, content drafts, resources, and earnings history.
- Important: eligibility, attribution, refunds, checks, and payout rules follow the current program terms.

## Public pages

- Partner program: https://www.tabbio.com/partners
- Tabbio home: https://www.tabbio.com/
- Tabbio privacy: https://www.tabbio.com/en/privacy-policy
- Tabbio terms: https://www.tabbio.com/en/terms-of-service
